commands.command: set -e; printf 'CODEX='; command -v codex || true; printf 'CLAUDE='; command -v claude || true; printf 'NODE='; node --version; printf 'PNPM='; pnpm --version

set -e; echo '=== DASHBOARD CSS ==='; grep -n -A 16 -B 6 -E '^\.(dashboard|automation-card|automation-metrics|automation-summary|automation-status|icon-action|refresh-icon)' apps/mobile/src/theme/theme.css | head -n 520

set -e; echo '=== APP SHELL ==='; cat apps/mobile/src/app/appShell.css; echo '=== REFRESH BUTTON ==='; cat apps/mobile/src/components/RefreshIconButton.tsx; echo '=== ROUTES ZERO STATE ==='; grep -n -A 14 -B 8 -E 'installations.length|route.type === .dashboard.|route.type === .intent.' apps/mobile/src/routes/AppRoutes.tsx

set -e; adb start-server >/dev/null; DEVICES=$(adb devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" {print $1}'); test "$DEVICES" = "RFCT70L7E8J"; MODEL=$(adb -s RFCT70L7E8J shell getprop ro.product.model | tr -d '\r'); test "$MODEL" = "SM-S906B"; echo PHONE_OK=$MODEL; adb -s RFCT70L7E8J shell wm size; adb -s RFCT70L7E8J shell wm density
